review_scope: paired exact sign-test and Holm correction as the primary inferential procedure
bootstrap confidence intervals as descriptive median-difference intervals
active_fraction saturation at 1.0 for 1d/2d/3d and its consequence for endpoint discrimination
first_output_latency_censored semantics: 128-tick window, sentinel 129 only for missing output, and whether any evaluation run was actually censored
matched 64-neuron and 246-edge budgets across all evaluation conditions
faster first-output latency of 5d_shuffled/random_graph relative to 5d
claim boundary between H-SNN-003-B and H-5D-005-A
interpretation_boundary: The 64-neuron result supports topology-sensitive propagation within the preregistered Stage-1 regime. It does not establish 5D superiority and does not satisfy the separate >=1000-neuron test programme for H-5D-005-A.
note: Review completion may accept or reject the interpretation. It must not rewrite source-bound DATA or automatically create EVID.

methodological_review_notes.active_fraction: 1d, 2d and 3d have median active_fraction 1.0. Treat the zero contrasts as endpoint saturation within this operating envelope, not as proof of topological equality.
methodological_review_notes.latency_censoring: The evaluation window is 128 ticks and the censor sentinel is 129. The reviewer should verify the raw DATA for censored runs; a latency of 19 is not itself censor-boundary behavior.
methodological_review_notes.inference: The preregistered exact paired sign test with Holm correction carries primary inference. Bootstrap intervals summarize paired median differences and may be degenerate for discrete identical differences.
methodological_review_notes.topology_budget: All evaluation conditions use 64 neurons and 246 edges, so observed effects must not be described as simple global density/sparsity effects.
methodological_review_notes.five_d_boundary: 5d_shuffled and random_graph reach output earlier than regular 5d in this regime; no 5D superiority interpretation is permitted.
methodological_review_notes.robustness_question: A lower-activity follow-up regime may test robustness of active_fraction discrimination, but is not automatically required to preserve the existing preregistered DATA result.

schema_versioning_note: analysis/statistics.json is frozen source-bound DATA and is not rewritten post hoc. Future analysis artifact generators should include an explicit schema_version field.
